memberdef.name: matchDataPoint

briefdescription.para: Inspects the visible XY series and heatmaps of a plot at a cursor and publishes one model row per series.

detaileddescription.para: Series that draw data points as areas, such as HeatmapSeries, report the record under the cursor in every mode, and only while the cursor has both coordinates; radius, interpolate, and summaries do not apply to them, and snapToDataPoint moves both crosshair coordinates to the record's center.

The cursor follows the plot's pointer by default; set followPointer to false and write cursorX to drive it from code, for example to link the crosshairs of several plots, or cursorPixelX to keep it at a pixel while the axes pan or zoom. Results are refreshed at most once per event-loop pass.
In QML, declare Crosshair, InspectionMarkers, and InspectionTooltip inside the inspector: they receive it as their inspector and are stacked in declaration order, the last one on top.
